entity_title: Secure an approved RPTKA before any foreign hire
fact_text: Before a foreign professional can be employed in Indonesia, the employer must hold a Foreign Worker Utilization Plan (RPTKA) that has been approved (disahkan) by the Minister of Manpower. The RPTKA - not the individual - is the legal foundation of the whole work-authorization chain; no notification, work visa or KITAS can issue without it.
evidence_quote: Setiap Pemberi Kerja TKA yang mempekerjakan TKA wajib memiliki RPTKA yang disahkan oleh Menteri atau pejabat yang ditunjuk.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the employee obtains a work permit like a visa stamp. Actually the employer must first hold an RPTKA approved by the Ministry of Manpower. Action: confirm the employer has a valid pengesahan RPTKA covering your exact position before planning travel.

entity_title: Your employer sponsors the work visa - you cannot self-apply
fact_text: The C312 work visa is initiated by the Indonesian sponsoring company, not by the foreign worker. The sponsor first registers the RPTKA, and only after the RPTKA and the Notifikasi have been issued can the C312 work visa be applied for - the visa is the last step, not the first.
evidence_quote: Penjamin (perusahaan) Tenaga Kerja Asing harus mendaftarkan Rencana Penggunaan Tenaga Kerja Asing (RPTKA) terlebih dahulu di website tka-online.kemnaker.go.id. Setelah mendapatkan pengesahan penggunaan TKA melalui RPTKA dan Notifikasi, barulah Visa Kerja C312 dapat diajukan.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed you apply for an Indonesian work visa yourself at an embassy. Actually the sponsoring employer drives it, and the visa comes only after RPTKA + Notifikasi. Action: do not expect to self-lodge; wait for your employer's notifikasi before any visa step.

entity_title: Lodge the C312 work visa via TKA Online, not the visa portal
fact_text: Unlike other Indonesian visas filed on the general visa-online portal, the C312 work visa must be submitted through the Ministry of Manpower's TKA Online system, which then triggers a notification into immigration's SIMKIM for the visa itself.
evidence_quote: Tidak seperti jenis visa lain yang diajukan lewat website visa online, Visa Kerja C312 harus diajukan melalui website TKA Online Kemnaker RI.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed all Indonesian visas are lodged on the same evisa website. Actually the C312 work visa goes through TKA Online (Kemnaker), not the visa-online portal. Action: have your employer file via tka-online.kemnaker.go.id, not the standard evisa site.

entity_title: Budget the US$100/month DKPTKA levy per foreign worker
fact_text: For each foreign worker the employer must pay the DKPTKA compensation levy of US$100 per position, per person, per month, remitted as non-tax state revenue (PNBP) or a regional levy. Even a foreign worker employed for less than a month is charged a full month.
evidence_quote: Pemberi Kerja TKA yang mempekerjakan TKA wajib membayar DKPTKA yang besarnya US$100 (seratus dolar Amerika Serikat) per jabatan per orang per bulan sebagai PNBP atau pendapatan daerah berupa retribusi daerah.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the foreign-worker fee is a single one-off payment. Actually DKPTKA is US$100 per person per position every month of the assignment. Action: confirm the employer bears it and that it is budgeted for the full contract length.

entity_title: Every foreign hire needs an Indonesian understudy
fact_text: A foreign worker must be paired with a designated Indonesian counterpart (Tenaga Kerja Pendamping) whom the employer appoints and prepares specifically for transfer of technology and skills. This understudy requirement is a built-in condition of using foreign labour.
evidence_quote: Tenaga Kerja Pendamping TKA adalah tenaga kerja Indonesia yang ditunjuk oleh Pemberi Kerja TKA dan dipersiapkan sebagai pendamping TKA yang dipekerjakan dalam rangka alih teknologi dan alih keahlian.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a foreign hire simply performs the role. Actually the employer must name and train an Indonesian companion worker for knowledge transfer. Action: ensure a pendamping is named in the RPTKA so an inspection does not flag the placement.

entity_title: Your employer must fund your Bahasa Indonesia training
fact_text: Among the RPTKA commitments, the employer must facilitate Indonesian-language education and training for the foreign worker. It is a legal obligation on the company that accompanies the placement, not merely an optional perk.
evidence_quote: memfasilitasi pendidikan dan pelatihan bahasa Indonesia kepada TKA.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed language learning is optional and self-funded. Actually the employer commits in the RPTKA to facilitate Bahasa Indonesia training for the foreign worker. Action: ask HR to document the Bahasa Indonesia training the company will provide.

entity_title: Your KITAS is locked to one employer and one position
fact_text: An RPTKA authorizes a foreign worker only for a specific position (jabatan tertentu) and a specific period (jangka waktu tertentu). The work authorization and the KITAS that follow are therefore tied to that single employer and role - changing employer or job requires a new RPTKA first.
evidence_quote: Rencana Penggunaan Tenaga Kerja Asing yang selanjutnya disingkat RPTKA adalah rencana penggunaan TKA pada jabatan tertentu dan jangka waktu tertentu.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a KITAS lets you work broadly or move between jobs. Actually it is bound to one named position and time window under the RPTKA. Action: any promotion, role change or new employer needs a fresh RPTKA before you start the new role.

entity_title: Cross 183 days and you become an Indonesian tax resident
fact_text: An individual - Indonesian or foreign - who is present in Indonesia for more than 183 days within any 12-month period becomes a domestic tax subject (Subjek Pajak Dalam Negeri). A KITAS or work contract longer than 183 days can also evidence intent to reside and make you resident earlier.
evidence_quote: berada di Indonesia lebih dari 183 (seratus delapan puluh tiga) hari dalam jangka waktu 12 (dua belas) bulan

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed you only owe Indonesian tax on local salary, or only after a full calendar year. Actually 183 days in a rolling 12-month window (or intent to reside) makes you a resident taxpayer. Action: track your day-count and take local tax advice before crossing 183 days.

entity_title: As a tax resident, Indonesia taxes your worldwide income
fact_text: Indonesia applies the domicile principle: a domestic tax subject is taxed on income earned both inside and outside Indonesia (world-wide income). Once you are resident, foreign-source income falls in scope, subject to any applicable double-tax treaty relief.
evidence_quote: menggabungkan asas domisili (kependudukan) dengan konsep pengenaan pajak atas penghasilan baik yang diperoleh di negara itu maupun penghasilan yang diperoleh di luar negeri

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed Indonesia only taxes Indonesia-source income. Actually resident taxpayers are taxed on worldwide income. Action: review home-country income and any double-tax treaty with a tax adviser once you become resident.

entity_title: Enroll in BPJS Ketenagakerjaan after 6 months of work
fact_text: Under the BPJS Law, a 'participant' expressly includes any foreigner who works at least 6 months in Indonesia and pays contributions. Employers must therefore enroll qualifying foreign workers in BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (work-accident, death and old-age social security).
evidence_quote: Peserta adalah setiap orang, termasuk orang asing yang bekerja paling singkat 6 (enam) bulan di Indonesia, yang telah membayar iuran.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed foreign workers are exempt from Indonesian social security. Actually foreigners working 6 months or more must be enrolled. Action: confirm your employer registers you with BPJS Ketenagakerjaan once the 6-month threshold is met.

entity_title: Register with Dukcapil for an SKTT within 14 days of your KITAS
fact_text: A foreigner holding a Limited Stay Permit (Izin Tinggal Terbatas / KITAS) must report to the local civil-registration office (Dukcapil) within 14 days of the permit being issued to obtain a Residence Certificate (SKTT). The SKTT is the civil-registration counterpart to your immigration KITAS and is separate from it.
evidence_quote: Orang Asing yang memiliki Izin Tinggal Terbatas yang datang dari luar negeri dan Orang Asing yang memiliki izin lainnya yang telah berubah status sebagai pemegang Izin Tinggal Terbatas yang berencana bertempat tinggal di wilayah Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia wajib melaporkan kepada Instansi Pelaksana paling lambat 14 (empat belas) hari sejak diterbitkan Izin Tinggal Terbatas untuk diterbitkannya Surat Keterangan Tempat Tinggal (SKTT) oleh Dispendukcapil Kota Salatiga.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the KITAS is the only local registration you need. Actually you must also register with Dukcapil within 14 days for an SKTT. Action: diarise the 14-day SKTT deadline from your KITAS issue date to avoid administrative penalties.
